about: Scripted replies for EDDY_FAKE_MODEL=scripted (never in production; docs/EDDY-SPEC.md 9.4). src/lib/eddy/model-binding.ts loads every *.json here, in name order. A member message picks the first scenario whose `match` it contains (case-insensitive), else `default`; the round within the turn picks the step. Tool calls name real v1 actions and go through the real action layer. The e2e/eddy.spec.ts panel scenarios ('e2e-eddy hinglish', 'tag vip', 'send reply', 'delete template') live in panel-e2e.json; a `match` must appear in only one file (tests/eddy-integration-seams.test.ts), because the file that sorts first would silently win.
